decisions.label: Left to right
decisions.note: How strongly the stars light left to right against a random scatter (loading.sweep; 3 as built, 0 plain random; Ed, 2026-11-05: "roughly left to right, with some random scatter"). Remembered on this browser; takes effect on the next load (the screen is over before the game can pause).

decisions.label: Stars a second
decisions.note: At most this many stars light a second, so a jump in the load fills over a moment (loading.rate; 90 as built). Remembered on this browser; takes effect on the next load (the screen is over before the game can pause).

decisions.label: Flash
decisions.note: How long each star flashes as it lights, seconds (loading.flash; 0.6 as built). Remembered on this browser; takes effect on the next load (the screen is over before the game can pause).

decisions.label: Unlit stars
decisions.note: How bright the stars not yet lit show (loading.ghost; 0 as built: an empty sky, Ed's call, 2026-10-26). Remembered on this browser; takes effect on the next load (the screen is over before the game can pause).

decisions.label: Supernova
decisions.note: The heart's star going supernova to white, seconds (loading.nova; 2.6 as built). Remembered on this browser; takes effect on the next load (the screen is over before the game can pause).

decisions.label: Frames a second
decisions.note: How often the screen draws while the game loads (loading.fps; 10 as built): each frame costs the load a little (at 20 its cold load in the cloud came 5.4 s later). About 20 once it's ready, for the supernova. Remembered on this browser; takes effect on the next load (the screen is over before the game can pause).

decisions.label: Depth
decisions.note: How far the seal's stars scatter in depth, seal units (loading.depth; 0.6 as built; Ed, 2026-11-05: "2 with a touch of 3", "make the random depth scatter quite large"): the knot's stars a 3D cloud sliding past each other as the view sways, the words' less, all of it at the start and none once every star's lit. Remembered on this browser; takes effect on the next load (the screen is over before the game can pause).
